type_definitions.name: date_and_time
type_definitions.description: Date and time in an ISO format, e.g. 2023-07-11T01:17:32Z represented as a string

types.name: abbreviation
types.description: The abbreviation used by astronomers to access the POLIS object.

types.name: api_support
types.description: Defines the three levels of POLOS API support. Currently, only static_data is fully supported..

types.name: data_format
types.description: Defines various POLIS data formats. Currently, only JSON is fully supported..

types.name: end_time
types.description: The ending/closing date of the observing facility.

types.name: external_references
types.description: External references connecting the item to an external data source, such as RTML or VO IDs, or URLs to documentation.

types.name: last_update_time
types.description: Date and time of the last change of the item in an ISO format, e.g. 2023-07-11T01:17:32Z.

types.name: lifecycle_status
types.description: It defines the readiness of an item to be actively used.

types.name: local_name
types.description: Provides a human-readable name for the object in the local script and language.

types.name: name
types.description: The name of the POLIS object. It is recommended to be (semi-)unique, although this is not mandatory.

types.name: polis_registration_time
types.description: The time of the initial registration of the POLIS object.

types.name: short_description
types.description: This is a short description of the POLIS object. It is recommended that English be used.

types.name: start_time
types.description: The time when the POLIS objects began their existence, such as the first light of a telescope.

types.name: version
types.description: Semantic Versioning of the POLIS implementation (see: SemanticVersioning: https://semver.org)
